objective: Calibrate fixed Fullhouse policy against near-zero, near-50 and near-80 score opponents.
score: 100 * final_hero_chips / total_chips, equal to 2-player ICM payouts [100,0]; bust gives 0 or 100.
target: Original released Fullhouse weights and decisions; previously validated FP32 ONNX execution.
sampling: One independent unit = two matches with identical seed-driven decks and swapped bot seats. Separate policy RNG and deck RNG. Opponent memory resets per match.
hard_implementation: Local implementation inspired by LBR; full 1225-combo initial range, public action Bayesian updates, 16 runouts per combo, utility stack**0.25, bet grid 0.125/0.25/0.5/1/2 pots plus all-in. Knows fixed policy, no actual opponent private cards or deck.
precision: Report 95% confidence interval on independent paired-match mean; hard planned sample fixed before confirmation, aiming for about 1-2 point half-width, not zero variance.
engine_adapter: Correct forced blind all-ins and run out matched all-ins when <=1 player can act; original third-party files unchanged. Also require call/fold after short all-in increments, without assuming a full raise. Run out immediately after matched all-in calls, including short small-blind all-in calls.
